metadata.title: Audited independent typed-edge evidence consensus
metadata.research_question: Is missing-link recovery constrained by weak support for the cause-to-deviation edge, the deviation-to-consequence edge, or both?
metadata.support_definition: Distinct eligible training scenario IDs supporting each typed edge independently. Cause-edge support is restricted to the query's known cause; consequence-edge support is computed over the eligible process family.
metadata.path_composition: The two edges may be supported by different scenarios. Thresholds are applied independently to the two audited graph-context edge types. Other graph predicates are excluded in thresholded conditions; GraphReasoner determines whether retained edges form a valid typed path. The (1,1) condition is an exact unfiltered graph-context pass-through baseline.

reasoning_instrumentation.candidate_paths: Captured from GraphReasoner._find_paths(). These are validated paths discovered in the filtered graph context.
reasoning_instrumentation.selected_paths: Captured from GraphReasoner._build_path_relation(). These are paths selected for relation construction.
reasoning_instrumentation.prediction_matching: A selected path is matched to emitted predictions using its constructed relation object endpoint.

metadata.support_scope: All eligible training records in the target plant unit; equipment fallback when plant unit is unavailable.
metadata.label_warning: Reconstructed row-level associations are silver labels, not expert-validated causal ground truth.
metadata.independence_warning: Distinct scenario IDs may share source templates and assumptions; they do not establish statistical independence or physical confirmation.
